analyst.summary: Ethos is India's leading luxury and premium watch retailer, expanding its boutique network briskly (now 103 stores) with strong revenue growth. However, profit has grown much more slowly than revenue in the last year, and return on equity remains under 10% even as the stock trades at a rich valuation. We rate this a Hold, with the store-expansion story needing to show through in the bottom line before the valuation is fully earned.
